summary: The diff modifies useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout.ts and AdminDashboard.tsx to address the race condition and timeout issues in the Admin Dashboard. REQ-1 is largely addressed: the hook now waits for the actor to be ready before firing the admin check, arms a timeout, exposes an actorWaiting state, and includes a retry mechanism. REQ-2 is partially addressed in useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout.ts via anonymous identity detection and principal-keyed run logic, but useActor.ts is not modified and no wrapper hook is added to guarantee the actor is always instantiated with the authenticated identity.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the backend actor in useActor.ts is always instantiated using the authenticated Internet Identity principal when the user is logged in. The actor must not fall back to an anonymous identity while an authenticated identity is available.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff does not modify useActor.ts and no wrapper hook replacing its actor instantiation behavior is added. The ACs requiring that all backend calls use the authenticated actor, that the actor is re-created on identity changes, and that no admin backend call is made with an anonymous principal are not verifiably satisfied at the actor instantiation level.
